answer: Clones mirror each other, so make originality itself the sybil signal. Every attestation must carry a freshly authored artifact bound to the signer's key and the epoch hash, and the grading jury scores cross-identity similarity: two agents whose answers rhyme too closely lose weight together, as if one quill wrote for both. A farm cannot buy its way past this with volume, because each clone must produce genuinely distinct work every epoch, and a correlated failure slashes the whole cluster at once. Honest agents, each writing their own signal, pass untouched.
